liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Drum Break**: cut on the recording; with guest artists: Airto Moreira and Flora Purim [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-13.124551.aud.goldshine.sennheiser-mkh406.flyingm.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 152 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1980-12-13.sbd.miller.91939.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 4.11/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Well-balanced mix with some hiss from extra analog generation; Clean, full sound features Phil finally heard on an early 80s SBD [18][20]
- **gd1980-12-13.157570.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 156 min [4]
- **gd1980-12-13.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.88964.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [6]. Said about its sound: Full, deep sound with rich bass and crisp highs, unlike thin raspy recordings; Quality audience recording preferred over sterile soundboard mix; Audience feel is loud and engaging, changing the reviewer's SBD preference [13][15][16][17]

## Around the show

- Guests: guest artists: Airto Moreira and Flora Purim [1]
- High energy vibe from start to finish, specifically the Stranger opener [16]
- Garcia delivers raunchy, reckless guitar performances throughout the show [17]
- Band is tight after October three-set shows; Jerry's leads are raw and distorted [22]
- Suggested as a matrix source with Nak fobs for improved quality [18]
- Solid early 80s performance with a standard 1980 setlist [22]
- Scarlet Begonias/Fire on Mountain performance rivals 8/6/89 and 11/29/80 [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-13.124551.aud.goldshine.sennheiser-mkh406.flyingm.flac16**: taped by Ron Goldshine ;John Musgrave ;Mark the B-Man ;Mike Martin; transferred by Mike Martin; source: Recorded from the 15th row dead center on the floor with the microphones about 10 feet apart; Source: 2 Sennheiser MKH 406 TUD microphones > Sony D5M (w/ Dolby… [1]
- **gd1980-12-13.sbd.miller.91939.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) D [3]. Also: Nakamichi 300 cassette master supplies Fire on the Mountain and encore [3]
- **gd1980-12-13.157570.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [4]. Also: Scott Wiseman cassettes and Charlie Miller's Nakamichi 700 source used for patches [4]
- **gd1980-12-13.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.88964.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [6]. Also: Recorded by Walker-Scotton and processed by Charlie Miller; Joani Walker and Paul Scotton provided FOB tapes; Nakamichi 700 to DAT [6][13]
